contract: Actual SU adapter: QK score -> exp score, sink denominator, post-PV divide.

depths.reducer: 26 + 3*log2(S/8) + 3*L (L = time levels when the row spans vectors)

wire_stage_derivation.controller: at the lane array's centre, which is HUB_SU_VECTOR's centre height; the array abuts HUB_VM
wire_stage_derivation.not_modelled: the operand reads (rd_addr -> rd_q, 4 streams) and the gather index read cross the same array to the vector memory; the unit's fetch depth (3) assumes a one-cycle memory beside every lane

operand_read_streams.note: rd_addr / rd_q: A, B, C, D per lane, each 32 bits (VM, CROM lo/hi or WROM)

index_read.note: vi_q: the gather index read (IND_I / IND_O)

kv_write.note: kv_we / kv_wdata (a separate KV SRAM port)

vm_banks_256b.note: the bench gives every lane and stream an independent one-cycle port; a banked VM needs every read stream's N words in distinct 256-bit banks each cycle (unit-stride rows), i.e. N*32/256 banks per stream.  The softmax chain uses A and B (VM) on op 0-3 and C (VM) on op 2; B is a broadcast per row (bso=1, bsi=0), so its N words hit one address.

currency.reason: W11 serial-domain change (claude/w11-suclose): MLAT/ALAT parameters, keep-prefix arithmetic and the three-cycle offset load were added; the unit is built at MLAT=3/ALAT=3 by default and that build is cycle-identical (rtl_hdc_v41x_vec_campaign at N16/N64 + vehicle + perf64, 3/3 at B4R5: every perf section equal to hdc_v41x_vec_campaign_wire.json; w11_su_softmax_spec N16 at 0:0 and 4:5: cycles equal).  The N1024 regeneration on these sources is queued (/tmp/claude-1000/w11s/queue/q_regen.sh); this marker is removed with it.
